blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A transcriber listening through one microphone also hears everyone near it. We train causal voice isolators: masking transformers of 140M, 243M and 374M parameters, 20 ms of latency, enrolling the caller from the call itself. Short evaluation windows hide two failures that real calls expose: forgetting the caller when another voice talks alone for a while, and damaging a caller who is alone. Long calls with turns, memory beyond the attention window, real headset crosstalk and drifting caller levels address both, but each trades one against the other. WavLM-Large's own weights, made causal and trained with the model, move the trade: M with them (555M parameters) lowers the error on our development sets from 11.44% to 10.55%; a student trained from scratch to imitate WavLM does not, and w2v-BERT 2.0 and Whisper's encoder, pre-trained on far more audio, help less or not at all. A lone caller loses most at the start of a recording: no training call opened with someone already talking. Training on windows cut from longer calls lowers the error on clean development calls from 3.92% to 2.96%; this is our release. Live, the release makes 16.13% word errors on 60 s AMI windows, against 23.66% for VoxLock, the strongest open isolator, and 10.19% on its own AMI windows, against 11.71%; it is level on Krisp's benchmark (5.74% against 5.63%), and a caller who is alone still loses more words than with VoxLock (5.58% against 2.92% on clean test calls). Distilled into 22.1M parameters without WavLM, it runs live on one CPU thread inside a LiveKit agent, at 33% of a core per call in 20 ms frames, with 10.66% error on our development sets (the release 10.49%). We open-source the release and this CPU model, with a LiveKit plugin, at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/voice-isolator.
blocks.zh: 一个通过一个麦克风收听的收发器也听到附近每个人的声音. 我们训练了因果语音隔离器:140M,243M和374M参数的口罩变压器,20毫秒的耐久性,将呼叫器从呼叫本身录入. 短评价窗口隐藏了真实通话暴露出的两个失败:在另一个语音单独交谈一段时间时忘记了呼叫者,并伤害了孤独的呼叫者. 有转弯的长时间呼叫,注意力窗口外的记忆,真实的耳机对口和漂移的呼叫器关卡都解决了这两个问题,但每个关卡都相互交换. WavLM-Large自己的权重,制造了因果并用模型训练,移动了交易:M与它们(555M参数)将我们开发集的错误从11.44%降低到10.55%;从头到尾训练来模仿WavLM的学生没有,而W2v-BERT 2.0和Whisper的编码器,预先在更远的音频上训练,帮助少或根本不用. 独家打电话者在录音开始时损失最多:没有培训电话与已经说话的人开通. 将清洁开发的误差从3.92%降低到2.96%, Live,发行量在60 s AMI 窗口上出现16.13%的字差,而最强开放同位素的VoxLock为23.66%,在自己的AMI 窗口上出现10.19%,比11.71%;在Krisp的基准上达到水平(5.74%对5.63%),单独一个呼叫者的字差仍然比VoxLock多(5.58%对2.92%的清洁测试通话). 在没有WavLM的情况下,它被分解为22.1M参数,运行在LiveKit代理内的一个CPU线程上,在20ms帧中以每通呼叫核心的33%进行活运行,我们的开发集错误率为10.66%(发布率为10.49%). 我们在https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/voice-isolator上以LiveKit插件开源发布和这个CPU模式.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A call-centre transcriber listens through one microphone, and so does everyone near it. On Krisp’s benchmark of 265 real
recordings with a second voice in the room ( Krisp Engineering Team, 2026 ) , Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 ( NVIDIA, 2025a ) gets 23.19% of the words wrong, almost all of them other people’s words (Figure 1 ).
A noise suppressor keeps them, because they are speech. VoxLock ( Siddiqui, 2026 ) , the strongest open
isolator, is a causal target-speaker extractor that takes its sample of the caller from the call itself.

blocks.en:
We train causal isolators for GPU serving, in three sizes, that start with no sample, enroll the caller from the loudest
3 s they have heard, and add no look-ahead to a 20 ms window ( Dubey et al., 2024 ) . The contributions: an open
evaluation that reproduces VoxLock’s and adds long meeting windows and real call-centre calls; two failures that short
windows hide, forgetting the caller over a long call and damaging a lone caller (much of it a cold start: recordings
open mid-sentence, training calls never did), and the training stages that address them; large pre-trained speech encoders made causal and trained inside the isolator, of which WavLM-Large improves both
failures at once; ablations of the objective, enrollment, speech, simulation, real crosstalk, model size and
resynthesis; a batched GPU server with its stress tests; a 22.1M student of the release for one CPU
thread; and a LiveKit plugin for both, measured inside running agents. The models are open at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/voice-isolator , the plugin at https://github.com/Scicom-AI-Enterprise-Organization/STT-API/tree/main/stt_api/livekit_plugin/voice_isolator .

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en:
Three problems. Noise suppression removes everything that is not speech and keeps every voice ( Reddy et al., 2021 ; Dubey et al., 2024 ; Schröter et al., 2023 ) . Target speaker extraction keeps one voice given a
clue about it, usually an enrollment clip ( Zmolikova et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Žmolíková et al., 2019 ; Xu et al., 2020 ; Ge et al., 2020 ; Zeng and Li, 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
Primary-speaker isolation keeps whoever is on the microphone; nearness alone is a weak cue ( Dubey et al., 2024 ; Patterson et al., 2022 ; Pärnamaa and Saabas, 2024 ) , so VoxLock cuts an enrollment from the call.
blocks.zh:
三个问题。 噪声抑制可以去除一切非言语,并保持每一个声音(Reddy等,2021;Dubey等,2024;Schröter等,2023.). 目标扬声器提取器保留一个声音
,通常为入学剪辑(Zmolikova等,2023;Wang等,2019;Žmolíková等,2019;Xu等,2020;Ge等,2020;Zeng和Li等,2025;Zhang等,2025)。
主语隔离让麦克风上的人保持住;而相近者则是一个微弱的提示(Dubey等,2024;Patterson等,2022;Pärnamaa和Saabas,2024),因此VoxLock从电话中切入一个入场.

blocks.en:
Two failures for a recogniser. Over-suppression deletes the caller’s words ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Iwamoto et al., 2022 ; Iwamoto et al., 2024 ; Sato et al., 2021 ) ; leakage inserts other people’s ( Dubey et al., 2024 ; Microsoft Research, 2022 ) . We report word error rate with its parts, as VoxLock does: missed words (substitutions and deletions), inserted words, and leaked words, recognised words whose midpoint
falls where only the background talks, per minute of that time.
blocks.zh:
两个失败的识别器。 过度打压删除了来电者的单词(王等等,2020;岩本等,2022;岩本等,2024;佐藤等,2021;渗出插入了其他人的单词(Dubey等,2024;微软研究,2022). 正如VoxLock所做的那样,我们报告文字错误率及其部分:遗漏了文字(替代和删除)、插入了文字并漏出文字、识别出其中点的文字。
掉到只有背景对话的地方,每分钟一次。

blocks.en:
Real recordings. Simulated mixtures overstate extraction on real conversations ( Li et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Krisp records the second voice for real and labels who talks when ( Krisp Engineering Team, 2026 ) ; AMI and NOTSOFAR give every
meeting participant a head-worn microphone that also hears the others ( Carletta et al., 2006 ; Vinnikov et al., 2024 ; Microsoft, 2024 ) . Intervals resample speakers, not files ( Bisani and Ney, 2004 ; Liu and Peng, 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
真实录音。 模拟混合物在真实对话中的多态提取(Li等,2025;Wang等,2026).
Krisp记录了真实和标签的第二个声音,
出席会议的还有同样听到其他声音的头发麦克风(Carletta等,2006年;Vinnikov等,2024年;微软,2024年)。 Intervals再现扬声器,不是文件(Bisani and Ney,2004;Liu and Peng,2020.).

blocks.en:
Latency. An overlap-add STFT model holds each sample for its window plus any look-ahead ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; the 2023 DNS challenge caps the sum at 20 ms ( Microsoft Research, 2022 ; Dubey et al., 2024 ) .
VoxLock’s is 24 ms, DeepFilterNet3’s 40 ms ( Schröter et al., 2023 ) . On GPUs a call also waits for its chunk
and for the batched step.
blocks.zh:
La. 一个相重叠的STFT模型将每个样板保存在它的窗口外加任何外观-头(Wang等,2023年;2023年DNS挑战封顶总和为20ms(Microsoft Research,2022;Dubey等,2024年).
VoxLock为24ms,DeepFilterNet3为40ms(Schröter等,2023年). 在GPUs上,一个呼叫也等待它的块
和分批步骤。

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en:
Every training example is a call simulated on the fly from clean speech (Figure 2 ). The target is the
person on the microphone alone, through the same room position, device and band as the mixture: the model never has to
invent bandwidth, and never has to keep anyone else.
blocks.zh:
每个训练例子都是从干净的演讲(图2)上模拟到苍蝇的呼叫. 目标就是
单靠麦克风的人,通过与混合物相同的房间位置、装置和波段:
发明带宽, 并且永远不必保留任何人。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: How a training example is made. Blue: the primary talker; amber: synthetic crosstalk; grey: noise; purple:
the enrollment. The device filters and band limit act on mixture and target alike; μ \mu -law, codecs and clipping on
the mixture only. Every probability is in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
图2:如何树立培训榜样。 蓝色:主讲;琥珀:合成对讲;灰色:噪声;紫色:
入学。 设备过滤器和波段限制混合物和目标的行为; μ\ mu - law、codecs和剪接
仅限混合物。 每一种可能性都载于附录C。

blocks.zh: 3.2 合成对白、噪音和线条

Seven examples in ten also carry an enrollment: 2 to 5 s of the same voice through the same position and device,
noisy in 60% of cases. The rest carry none, so the same model also learns to find the primary from the audio alone.
blocks.zh:
十分之七的例子也包含一个入场数: 同一声音的2到5 s通过同一位置和装置,
60%的病例都吵了 其余的则无所携带,因此同名模型也学会了单独从音频中找到初级.

blocks.en: 3.3 Long calls
blocks.zh: 3.3 长期电话

blocks.en:
Six-second examples teach separation, not memory: the caller is never silent for more than 3 s, so nothing teaches the
model to keep suppressing a voice that goes on talking. The long-call stage uses 24 s calls; in six of ten the caller
talks in turns and one background voice takes most of the pauses between them (Figure 10 ), so the caller
comes back after the other voice has talked alone, 4.5 s per call in stretches over 8 s against
0.0 s before.
blocks.zh:
六秒钟的例子教分离,而不是记忆: 召唤者从来没有沉默超过3 s,所以没有什么教
模式继续压制一个继续说话的声音。 长呼阶段使用24 s 调用;在10个调用者中,有6个调用
轮流交谈,一个背景声音占据了他们之间的大部分暂停(图10),所以呼叫者
在另一个声音单独说话之后 回来的,每通电话4.5S 长度超过8s对
0.0 s before. (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en:
Figure 10: Five simulated calls of the long-call stage (development speakers). Blue: the caller talks; amber: only the
background voice does. The caller often comes back after the other voice has talked alone for several seconds.
blocks.zh:
图10:长呼阶段的5个模拟电话(发展发言者)。 蓝色:呼叫者说话;琥珀:只有
背景声音是。 呼叫者经常在另一个声音单独交谈几秒钟后回来.

blocks.en: 3.4 Real callers
blocks.zh: 3.4 真正的呼叫者

blocks.en:
Four changes come from real callers (Section 6.4 ): the mixture level spans − 65 -65 to − 10 -10 dBFS (below − 45 -45 dBFS every model removed most of the caller); in half the long calls the caller’s level drifts, by gains drawn
every 1 to 4 s with a 4 dB spread; a third of the long calls have nobody else at all; and, in the release’s long-call
stage, three examples in ten are cut out of a call 0.5 to 3 s longer, so whoever talks at the cut is already talking
at the first sample.
blocks.zh:
4个变化来自真正的呼叫者(第6.4节):混合电位从-65-65到-10-10 dBFS(低于-45-45 dBFS);在半数长调中,通过得分,呼叫者电位漂移
每1至4 s,加上4分贝;三分之一的长通电话完全无人接;以及,在释放的长通电话中,
舞台上,十个中的三个例子 从一个电话0.5到3s更长, 所以谁在切口上说话 已经说话
在第一样本。

blocks.en: 3.5 Real crosstalk
blocks.zh: 3.5 真正的对讲

blocks.en:
From each AMI, NOTSOFAR and AliMeeting wearer’s channel ( Carletta et al., 2006 ; Vinnikov et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) , a
window where nobody else speaks is an exact target and a window where only others speak is real crosstalk at its
natural level. Only meetings outside every evaluation set are used: 362 meetings,
620 h.
blocks.zh:
从每个AMI、NOTSOFAR和Ali Meeting的收看频道(Carletta等,2006年;Vinnikov等,2024年;Yu等,2022年),a
没有人说话的窗口是准确的目标 只有其他人说话的窗口是真正的对白
自然水平。 只使用每套评价以外的会议:362次会议,
620 h (英语).

blocks.zh: 3.6 成套评价

blocks.en:
Short windows never hold more than 4 s of background-only speech; Krisp’s comes in stretches with a median of
16.9 s (Figure 11 ). We add 60 s AMI windows that each hold a stretch of at least

blocks.en: 4.1 Realtime: a causal transformer over frames

blocks.en:
Each 20 ms frame (10 ms hop) is split into 32 bands ( Luo and Yu, 2023 ; Yu et al., 2023 ) , encoded with attention across

transformer sees the last 10 s of tokens, with one LSTM over the tokens after its middle layer; a band decoder predicts a
complex mask. The sizes differ only in width (Table 2 ).

blocks.en:
The release adds WavLM-Large ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , pre-trained on 94k hours with overlapped speech, keeping its
weights and changing only what causality needs: the waveform is divided by its running level instead of the
utterance’s, the positional convolution keeps its 65 taps on the frame and the past (it looked 1.28 s ahead), and
attention is causal over the last 10 s, keeping the gated relative position bias. Its 20 ms frames arrive one tick
behind the tokens: token t t reads WavLM frame ⌊ t / 2 ⌋ − 1 \lfloor t/2\rfloor-1 , the last one complete, so no latency is added.
A learned mix of its 25 layers, each normalised, is projected and added to the tokens through a gate that starts at
zero, so the model starts as it was. w2v-BERT 2.0 ( Seamless Communication et al., 2023 ) and Whisper large-v3’s encoder ( Radford et al., 2023 ) were made causal the same way for comparison: a running normalisation of the filterbank,

blocks.en: 7 Serving
blocks.zh: 7 服务

blocks.en:
One GPU serves many calls (Figure 34 ). Each call keeps its state in a bank: the key-value cache of the
last 999 frames in every layer, kept as a ring with keys rotated by their absolute frame, the LSTM states and the
speaker vector, 82 MB for L. Every 20 ms one step, captured as a CUDA graph per batch size, runs
the network for every call with a chunk, in half precision, with the LSTMs and their states kept in single precision
(their cell state sums a whole call); on real calls it agrees with the offline model to 70 dB.
The release’s WavLM branch keeps a bank of its own in the same step: its input history, running level,
positional-convolution history, a key-value ring per layer and a frame counter per call, which marks the frame a call’s
first chunk cannot complete, so the step needs no branch. It moves in 20 ms frames, so chunks are multiples of 20 ms; a
call then keeps 115 MB, and the step agrees with the offline release to 69 dB.
blocks.zh:
一个GPU服务于许多呼叫(图34. 每次通话都保持银行状态:
每层最后999个帧, 保存为环, 键由它们的绝对帧旋转, LSTM 状态和
扬声器矢量,为 L. 每20 ms 一步, 作为 CUDA 图表捕获, 每批大小, 运行

(他们的细胞状态是一整通的);在真实的通话中,它同意离线模型为70分贝.
发行版的WavLM分行在同一个步骤上保持自己的银行:其输入历史,运行水平,

Two kernels of our own decide much of a step’s time (Figure 37 ). Each layer asks its ring for one or
two new frames per call, where the fused attention kernels tile 64 queries: ours (Triton) reads each key and value once
and builds the mask from each slot’s frame. The band LSTMs step thousands of two-frame sequences, which cuDNN runs
11 times slower than PyTorch’s own LSTM. A step of 64 calls then takes 11.6 ms
instead of 18.8 on 20 ms chunks, and its output agrees with the old step’s to 69 dB;
offline evaluation does not use them. Batch sizes come in steps of 16 calls (in powers of two, 80 calls ran as a step of
128), and the live enrollment’s encoder replays a CUDA graph per batch size, captured before the first call: run kernel
by kernel, it put a fresh server that took 64 calls at once 900 ms behind
(Figure 38 ). Over 30 minutes at 64 calls the release lost
no call and held its 99th percentile at 32 ms (Figure 39 ); the host’s memory grew

blocks.en: 8 In a voice agent
blocks.zh: 第8条 在语音代理

blocks.en:
A voice agent decides from the caller’s audio when to listen, when to answer and what was said: a voice activity
detector (VAD), a turn detector and the recogniser. LiveKit Agents, a framework many such agents run on, lets an audio
filter hear the call before all three: its audio input takes any frame processor, an object called once per incoming
frame inside the agent’s process. We ship the isolator as one (Figure 40 ). It needs neither a GPU nor
PyTorch: one streaming step of the model is exported to ONNX with everything a call keeps between steps passed in and
out, and numpy does the STFT, the overlap-add, the attention rings and the live enrollment rule. On real calls the
exported stream reproduces the PyTorch model to 124 dB with live enrollment and
128 dB without, which is float rounding.

LiveKit hands the audio over in small frames, 50 ms by default, and that does not cut the model’s context. The model

3 s there is no speaker vector, and that is where the model still removes some of a lone caller’s first words
(Section 6.4 ).

the release as its teacher.

blocks.en: 11 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en:
An isolator for transcription must remove every other voice however long it talks, and leave the caller alone however
quietly they speak; short evaluation windows test neither. Long windows showed that an attention window forgets the
caller, and lone real callers showed that fixing it makes the model doubt them. Width did not settle that trade (M beat
S, L did not beat M); WavLM’s own weights, made causal and trained inside the model, moved it, where a student imitating
WavLM, w2v-BERT 2.0 and Whisper’s encoder did not. Much of what a lone caller still lost was a cold start: recordings
open mid-sentence, and no training call did, until we cut training windows out of longer calls. The release is ahead of
VoxLock live on long meetings and on calls with a second voice, ahead or level on the other test meetings, level on
Krisp, and still behind it where the caller is alone. It costs about 47.7 GMAC per second of audio, and one GPU carries
160 live calls. The release and its CPU student, with the LiveKit plugin, are open at https://huggingface.co/collections/Scicom-intl/voice-isolator .

blocks.en: 12 Limitations
blocks.zh: 12 限制

blocks.en:
Recognisers. Every score comes from Parakeet or Whisper; other recognisers react differently to processing ( Iwamoto et al., 2024 ) . Calls. Krisp’s calls are scripted, and our call-centre windows carry a second voice
only as a mixture we made, with a recogniser’s transcript as reference. Enrollment. The live rule takes the
loudest 3 s; when someone else is loudest, as in many AliMeeting windows, it keeps the wrong voice. Selection. The meeting sets reward suppression and the clean calls restraint; another weighting picks another model. Two
training runs of one recipe at S land at 10.81 and 10.96%
on dev-4 and differ on the 60 s windows and the clean calls by more than our intervals over callers allow, which
resample callers, not training runs; at M two runs land at 10.55 and
10.61%. Dev-4 differences of a tenth of a point or two rank runs rather than recipes;
the release’s last step held in two seeds at M, by less than that. Cost. The WavLM branch adds 311M parameters and steps in 20 ms frames: no 10 ms chunks, and
fewer calls per GPU than M alone. WavLM was pre-trained on English. Licences. Krisp, ai-coustics’ calls and AppTek’s recordings are evaluation-only; results are for internal
study until a release is cleared.
